title: StripView
description: Response of GET /ui/crew/{astronaut_id}/views/strip: facts of the always-visible strip of the desktop UI (mission day, harness, ground link, reports due). Codes and data only; every unknown is an explicit null.

mission.title: StripMission
mission.description: Where the astronaut is in the mission, derived from launch_date and landing_date of the astronaut profile. Each field is null when it cannot be derived.

day.description: Mission day counted from the launch date (same numbering as mission_day of the daily context). Null without a launch date.

start.description: Launch date of the astronaut profile; the UI measures mission elapsed time from it.

harness.description: Last known status of the paired harness; null while no harness is paired or its last status is offline. A device whose last status is old is still listed, with stale true.

battery_pct.description: Null when the device did not report it.

weak_streams.description: Streams that are not sending (device-status stream state stalled or disabled). Empty when every stream is active.

degraded.description: True when the device status is degraded.

stale.description: True when the last device status is older than the app's staleness threshold (settings stale_device_hours): the other fields are then the last known ones, not the current state.

last_seen_at.description: Timestamp of the device status the other fields come from.

ground_link.description: State of the link with the ground station. Reserved: always null until the ground link is modelled (issue #62).

last_contact_min_ago.description: Minutes since the last contact with the ground station; null when unknown (always null until issue #62).
